description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Core::CyclicDataBuffer' class, testing its read, write, and buffer management functionalities using Google Test framework.

classes.name: Core::CyclicDataBuffer
classes.description: A cyclic (ring) buffer implementation for data storage with methods to write, read, and check buffer status.

methods.name: buffer.IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the cyclic buffer is empty.

methods.name: buffer.Filled
methods.description: Returns the amount of data currently stored in the buffer.

methods.name: buffer.Free
methods.description: Returns the remaining free space in the buffer.
